The name of the planet humans live on is Earth.

The legal precedent mentioned in the text is Loving v. Virginia. This case is similar to the case at hand because both involve challenges to state laws that restrict the legal recognition of marriages based on the characteristics of the individuals involved (race in Loving v. Virginia and sexual orientation in the recent case). Both cases center on the argument that such restrictions violate constitutional rights to marry and equal protection under the law.
